text:
Silver Price in 1970
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1970, the LBMA silver price fell 14.6% between 1970-01-30 ($1.91) and 1970-12-31 ($1.63). The highest sampled price was $1.91 in January and the lowest was $1.61 in June. The mean of these observations was $1.75. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
